_note: C3 fix: these constants used to be bare literals inside calculator_agent.py, rounded to 2dp in every response as if they were measured. None of them are backed by a cited study - they are placeholder assumptions carried over from the original implementation. Moving them here makes that visible and makes them easy to calibrate per-region without a code change. Replace `source` with a real citation before treating this calculator's output as anything more precise than a rough estimate.

transportation_cost_per_kg.source: UNSOURCED PLACEHOLDER - not derived from regional trucking rate data.

storage_cost_per_kg.source: UNSOURCED PLACEHOLDER - not derived from regional storage/warehousing rate data.

biochar_yield_fraction.unit: fraction of dry input mass converted to biochar
biochar_yield_fraction.source: UNSOURCED PLACEHOLDER - slow-pyrolysis biochar yields are typically cited in the 25-35% range depending on feedstock and process, but this value is not tied to a specific study or feedstock.

biogas_yield_fraction.unit: fraction of dry input mass converted to biogas
biogas_yield_fraction.source: UNSOURCED PLACEHOLDER - biogas yield is highly feedstock- and process-dependent; not tied to a specific study.

co2_saved_per_kg.unit: kg CO2-equivalent avoided per kg of waste diverted
co2_saved_per_kg.source: UNSOURCED PLACEHOLDER - not tied to a specific emissions-factor study or disposal-avoidance pathway.

default.source: Generic fallback used when the crop name is not recognized.
